name: context-drill
description: A Context pane that drills into what fills the window, read when it opens, after each turn while it is shown and on Refresh (a local estimate, no request sent): the /context categories as a stacked bar with the auto-compact tick and what grew since you opened it, the fill per turn against the auto-compact point, turns left before it fires, cache health, the heaviest messages and tokens by tool, then the memory files, MCP tools by server, agents and skills, and the startup cost against your average; a footer compacts with a focus you pick. Every part is a setting. Opened by /context-drill, or by $.contextDrill.open() from another mod (motta-statusline's ctx).

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: The stacked category bar's width: the pane's whole width, or blocks of ten squares (braille cells in a terminal).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The /context rows: one stacked bar with a legend, a list, the 100-square grid, or hidden.

categoryOrder.title: Category order
categoryOrder.description: The engine's own order, or largest first.

categoryHide.title: Hide small categories
categoryHide.description: Fold categories under this share of the window into one line.

thresholdToast.title: Threshold toast
thresholdToast.description: A toast, once, when the fill turns orange (50%) or red (70%) on the status line's ctx scale, from the figures the engine pushes after each turn.

history.title: Fill history
history.description: The fill after each turn as a line, over the last 24 or 12 turns, as of the last read.

historyGrowth.title: History growth
historyGrowth.description: The average growth per turn and the last turn's under the line.

forecast.title: Compact forecast
forecast.description: Turns left before auto-compact, at the session's average growth or the last five turns'.

since.title: Since
since.description: Each category's growth since the pane opened, or since the last compaction.

cache.title: Cache health
cache.description: The last request's input split into cache read, cache written and fresh: a bar, a line, or hidden.

heaviest.title: Heaviest messages
heaviest.description: The largest messages and tool results in the transcript, estimated locally.

heaviestKind.title: Heaviest: which
heaviestKind.description: Every message, or tool results alone.

byTool.title: Tokens by tool
byTool.description: Tool results summed per tool, the largest first.

byToolCalls.title: By tool: calls
byToolCalls.description: The number of calls beside each tool.

sectionsFolded.title: Folded sections
sectionsFolded.description: The drill sections folded when the pane opens: MCP tools, none or all.

sectionsMax.title: Section items
sectionsMax.description: How many items an open section lists.

paths.title: Memory file paths
paths.description: Full paths, from the home folder (~), or the file name.

compactActions.title: Compact actions
compactActions.description: The footer: a focus picker (presets and your own) with Compact now, or Compact now alone.

baseline.title: Startup baseline
baseline.description: What the context costs before your first message, against your average in this project or across all; kept in the plugin store.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: 12.3k, 12,345, or the share of the window.

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Read again after each turn while the pane is shown (the local estimate, no request sent), or only on Refresh. Nothing is read while the pane is closed.
